timestampPolicy: Unknown publishedAt remains null; fetchedAt must never be relabelled as publishedAt. All timestamps use UTC with original timezone retained where applicable.
identityPolicy: Provider ID mapping requires evidence. Name-only similarity creates a review candidate, never a verified identity.
coveragePolicy: Sample HTTP or schema success does not establish per-player or historical completeness. Expected seasons and games require independent inventories.
conflictPolicy: Keep both source observations. Choose authoritative fields by competition and effective date. Do not silently average conflicting facts.
nbaTotalsPolicy: Preserve provider season totals and team stints separately. Never add aggregate totals to constituent rows; transferred players may exceed 82 games.
historicalPopulation: Current draft catalog plus historical cohorts including inactive players, failed transitions and zero-NBA-minute prospects; completeness not yet established.
refreshPolicy: Targets are not achieved SLAs. Match data is rechecked after final status and next day. Sports catalog checked before draft/transfer and on detected change. Historical corrections use source-specific schedules not yet accepted.
checkpointStorage: GitHub Actions artifacts are temporary, currently 90 days; not the permanent online database.
acceptanceGates: Access method and applicable source conditions recorded
Sample response schema and parser semantics understood
Pagination and competition/season type filters verified
Identity conflicts resolved for draft-eligible players
unresolvedLeagueRules: Which matches contribute to the fantasy result
Active versus bench counting if applicable
Complete minute and match-result bonus table
knownPublicDataLimits: No assumed tracking history before the metric existed
No historical provider forecast unless an actual dated snapshot exists
